title: College Algebra
summary: Algebraic operations, equations and inequalities, functions and number systems at the level of a first college algebra course, anchored to every topic of the CLEP College Algebra outline.

topics.title: Real numbers and their properties
objectives: Classify a number as natural, integer, rational or irrational
Use the field properties and order of operations to simplify numeric expressions
Read and write intervals on the number line

topics.title: Exponents and radicals
objectives: Apply the product, quotient and power rules for integer exponents
Convert between rational exponents and radicals and simplify both

topics.title: Absolute value as distance
objectives: Evaluate and simplify absolute value expressions
Interpret |a - b| as the distance between a and b

topics.title: Polynomial arithmetic and factoring
objectives: Add, subtract and multiply polynomials, including special products
Factor by common factor, grouping, trinomial patterns, difference of squares and sums or differences of cubes

topics.title: Rational and radical expressions
objectives: Simplify, multiply, divide, add and subtract rational expressions, stating excluded values
Rationalize denominators and simplify complex fractions

topics.title: Linear equations and inequalities
objectives: Solve linear equations, including literal equations for a named variable
Solve linear and compound inequalities and write the answer in interval notation

topics.title: Absolute value equations and inequalities
objectives: Solve |ax + b| = c by splitting into cases and checking each
Solve |ax + b| < c and |ax + b| > c as compound inequalities

topics.title: Complex numbers
objectives: Add, subtract, multiply and divide complex numbers in a + bi form
Simplify powers of i and square roots of negative numbers

topics.title: Quadratic equations and inequalities
objectives: Solve quadratics by factoring, square roots, completing the square and the quadratic formula
Use the discriminant to predict the number and kind of roots
Solve quadratic inequalities with a sign chart

topics.title: Systems of equations and inequalities
objectives: Solve two- and three-variable linear systems by substitution and elimination
Solve a nonlinear system with one quadratic equation
Graph the solution region of a system of linear inequalities

topics.title: Functions and their representations
objectives: Decide whether a relation given as a table, graph, formula or description is a function
Evaluate functions, including at expressions such as f(x + h)
Build a linear model from a word problem and interpret slope and intercept

topics.title: Domain and range
objectives: Find the domain of polynomial, rational, radical and logarithmic formulas
Read domain and range from a graph and write them in interval notation

topics.title: Graphs, symmetry and transformations
objectives: Find intercepts and test for even, odd and axis symmetry
Graph shifts, reflections and stretches of the basic functions, including vertex form of a quadratic

topics.title: Polynomial, rational, power and piecewise functions
objectives: Sketch a polynomial of degree at most five from its zeros, multiplicities and end behavior
Find the vertical and horizontal asymptotes and holes of a rational function
Evaluate and graph piecewise functions

topics.title: Combining and composing functions
objectives: Form sums, differences, products and quotients of functions with their domains
Compose functions and decompose a formula into a composition

topics.title: Inverse functions
objectives: Test a function for one-to-one with the horizontal line test
Find an inverse algebraically and verify it by composition
Relate the graphs of a function and its inverse

topics.title: Exponential and logarithmic functions
objectives: Graph exponential and logarithmic functions and state their domain, range and asymptote
Use the product, quotient and power properties and the change of base formula
Model growth and decay, including compound interest

topics.title: Exponential and logarithmic equations
objectives: Solve exponential equations by matching bases or taking logarithms
Solve logarithmic equations and reject solutions outside the domain

topics.title: Factorials and the binomial theorem
objectives: Simplify expressions with factorials and compute binomial coefficients
Expand (a + b)^n and find a single named term
